sourceData.answer: To Get Irritated, To Get Annoyed, To Grow Impatient
sourceData.mnemonic: Double <kanji>frustration</kanji> would cause anyone <vocabulary>to get irritated</vocabulary>, <vocabulary>to get annoyed</vocabulary>, or <vocabulary>to grow impatient</vocabulary>.
sourceData.readingMnemonic:
This isn’t the reading you learned with the kanji, so here's a mnemonic to help you:

You don’t just get irritated, you get <reading>ira-ira</reading>-tated (<ja>いらいら</ja>). That's the next level up from irritated.

This word is often written in katakana or hiragana, but you'll sometimes see it in kanji too, so it's worth knowing!
